errors.evidence: The description states that the bars for "Внос" (import) have horizontal lines, but the figure shows they are filled with diagonal lines.
The description states the range for imports and exports is up to 65% of GDP. However, the bar for "Внос" (import) in 2007 clearly exceeds this, reaching approximately 68%.
The description states that the total trade line reaches its maximum in 2008. Visually, the peak of the line is in 2006 (at approx. 113%), which is higher than the value in 2008 (approx. 110%).
